notes: Human (left) hand, entering from the upper left. Provenance: started from round-1 LEFT_HAND_SPEC in src/hand/skeleton.ts, then re-read against aes-ref/alpha-white-geom.PNG on 4-8x zoomed crops (the step-2 start pose). Digit names follow user decision D2 (documentations/log/log-v2.md): THUMB = the digit with the large nail facing the viewer, coming diagonally out of the base of the palm (tip ~(562,458), D13); PINKY = the short leftmost digit curled under the palm, pointing back toward the wrist, tip ~(438,438); MIDDLE and RING = the two curled digits between, tips ~(601,523) and ~(532,505); INDEX = the extended digit reaching the contact point, tip (786,416). CALIBRATED (log-v2 step 2, 2026-09-21/22): every joint px and r fitted to assets-source/reference/left-mask.png with a surrogate of build_hands.py's own SDF (ray-sampled at pixel centres; Levenberg-Marquardt on the edge offset at every reference edge pixel, beyond 1.2 px, plus a per-region thickness balance) and checked with Blender builds, under anatomical constraints: every joint within 2.7x its keypoints.json uncertainty (gate 3x, D16); radii taper base->tip; 3D phalanx lengths within +-10 % of the start pose, except the index middle/distal phalanges, held to the reference keypoints (the start pose had them 12-15 % short), and the pinky middle/distal phalanges, held to anatomical ratios of its proximal one (the start pose had P2 > P1); fingertip px finally set with Blender builds so the tip rule of scripts/compare_silhouette.py lands within its gate. r = projected half-width in reference px as fitted. RECONSTRUCTED (not observable in one view) and left as in the start pose: z depths (index and thumb toward the camera, ring and pinky away, consistent with the drawn overlaps), flat, and dorsal [0.4, 0.86, 0.32] (fits that freed them rotated the dorsal 33 deg or flared the carpus into a wide thin wedge seen from above, for little silhouette gain). The forearm px lies outside the frame so the arm leaves the frame. Residual against the left gates (contour p95 ~4 px vs 2.0): outputs/qa/calib/compare-left/ and the step-2 report.
